_meta.name: xp commerce evaluation set
_meta.purpose: Repeatable regression harness for commerce intelligence: transparent configurable scoring, supplier/listing comparison, vehicle auction checks, canned ad-library integration, landed-cost template, freshness/confidence. All pages are offline fixtures (.test TLD); no network is touched.
quality_bars: only accessible and permitted fixture sources are represented as searched
the report layer distinguishes asking prices (estimates), official published rates (observed), and verified costs (none exist here, disclosed)
no demand, ad-performance, or availability measure is invented: scoring has no such factor and ad summaries exclude performance keys
scoring factors and their weights are visible and configurable (config echoed in every verdict)
